newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks lower, Boatmen's soars.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks lower, Boatmen's soars.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks closed mixed ahead of the extended U.S. Labor Day weekend as stronger than forecast eceonomic data sent the bond market into a tailspin.

But one stock, Boatmen's Bancshares Inc, had a banner day, rising 10-5/16 to 53-1/4 in active trading after news it had agreed to merge with NationsBank Corp. NationsBank shares tumbled 7-1/4 to 85-1/8 in active trade.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was down 3.54 points, or 0.31 percent, at 1141.49 at its unofficial close, while advances led declining issues by 1976 to 1876 on slim volume of 340 million shares.

Nasdaq followed the rest of the market lower after a spate of data, especially a stronger than forecast August Chicago PMI, ambushed the market and raised the fear, yet again, that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next month.
Other active issues included ValuJet Inc, which was up 1-1/2 at 12-1/2 after the airline on Thursday won tentative approval from U.S. aviation authorities to resume operations.
